title: Implement artifact verification before extraction
description: Verify the downloaded artifact's checksum and manifest before extraction or service changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Installer downloads to a temporary file, computes SHA-256, and compares it with the expected release checksum
Manifest version, architecture, and artifact filename match the requested pinned release
A mismatch, malformed archive, path traversal entry, or unexpected top-level layout aborts before touching the active release
No secret values are emitted in failure logs

steps.details: Test good checksum plus negative fixtures for changed bytes, wrong architecture, malformed manifest, and archive path traversal.
Use a version-pinned URL and a temporary download path; verify before extraction and clean up safely on failure.
List archive entries and reject absolute paths, `..` traversal, symlink escapes, and unexpected executable placement.
Run all verification fixtures and the existing optimization harness.

technicalNotes: Do not use `tar -x` before validation. Use a controlled extraction directory and a fixed list of permitted top-level entries.
